title: Seagrove 25 Kristi Santa Rosa Beach, Florida 30A Vacay
description_expanded: OverviewPrivate Pool/Heat option-Gulf Views-4 Bikes-Private beach access- 1 Minute Walk -`Shore to Have Fun`The SpaceShore to Have Fun | Steps to the Sugar White SandHOME HIGHLIGHTS: Luxury Gulf View 4BR/4.5BA Beach Retreat (Sleeps 10!) Stunning Gulf Views – Take in breathtaking views Private Pool (Heat Optional) – Relax & unwind in your own oasis (heat optional) Screened-In Porch – Enjoy coastal breezes off the dining room Outdoor Pergola – Built-in fridge & grill for ultimate cookouts Spacious Outdoor Living – Multiple porches & seating areas 4 Adult Bikes Included – Cruise through Seagrove & beyond Ping Pong Table – Family-friendly fun at home! 4 Dedicated Parking Spots – Plenty of space for your group Professionally Managed, 24/7 Service – Stress-free vacationing 6-Seater Golf Cart Rental Option – Explore 30A with ease!Welcome to Shore to Have Fun!This Gulf view three story stunner in Seagrove Beach is sure to check every box on your next getaway.Step inside to be immediately welcomed by pristine timber flooring throughout this 4 bedroom 4.5 bath home. Immaculate granite countertops and a fresh Wolf range make this main level shine with the open concept kitchen/living room along with the screened in porch off the dining room. Boasting 2 bedrooms on the first floor 1 on the main and the master on top, this home is perfect for entertaining and keeping the family busy. The abundance of natural light shines through this home creating the perfect indoor/outdoor flow with the multiple walk out porches leading you to gorgeous views of the light blue waters down the street.As you stroll to the backyard you will find a giant pergola complimenting a built-in fridge and gas grill perfect for a cookout. Whether you’re taking a dip in the pool, or playing a friendly game of ping pong there is no shortage of outdoor activities. On top of the backyard fun, you're just a short walk to the private beach, there is no beating these amenities and this location!House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**Pool Heat*Pool heating available for this property from October 1st through May 1st*Fee $50 per day and required for length of stay*Pool heat is not guaranteed-hot tub overflow is not independently heated.DETAILS: This home boasts breathtaking gulf views, a luxurious private pool and convenient beach access just a short walk away. Comfortable furniture and inviting decor will make you feel right at home the moment you walk through the door.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (12):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Twin Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboSECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:- Master Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Soaking Tub and Separate Shower- Loft Area: Queen Sleeper SofaAREA ATTRACTIONS:Kick back, relax, and enjoy the South Walton lifestyle to the fullest at this fully-equipped home. Cruise the neighborhood by pedal power on the provided bikes, take in the splendor of the Gulf of Mexico on a beach day, spend the day relaxing by the sparkling pool, or enjoy an awe-inspiring sunset from your beautiful balcony—the choice is yours. Book your next stay today, and let the fun in the sun begin!Show less
